name: AC
tips: Clean or replace air filters every 1-2 months during high use. Schedule deep coil and coolant service every 6 months.

name: Refrigerator
tips: Clean condenser coils annually. Inspect door gaskets for tight seal to optimize power usage.

name: Washing Machine
tips: Run a hot water descaling cycle monthly. Clean inlet filters and inspect drum balance annually.

name: RO Purifier
tips: Replace sediment and carbon filters every 6 months. Check TDS and membrane health regularly.

name: Geyser
tips: Flush water tank and descale heating element annually. Check pressure relief valve safety.

name: Chimney
tips: Degrease baffle/mesh filters monthly. Schedule professional duct cleaning every 6 months.
